entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait until the price has gone at least to the first if not the second standard deviation
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to move away from VWAP to at least the first, preferably the second, standard-deviation band.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says to wait for price to extend to the outer VWAP bands before taking the continuation setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: after we broke it and tested it we can try our long trade
entry_sequence.action: After price breaks the chosen VWAP standard-deviation band and retests it, enter in the direction of the session bias.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup is a break-and-retest continuation trade.

targets.transcript_quote: use the second and third standard deviation as a Target
targets.rationale: The speaker says the second and third VWAP standard-deviation bands can be used as targets.

confluences.transcript_quote: say you might have a long idea for your session
confluences.name: session_bias
confluences.description: Trade in the direction of the session bias.

confluences.transcript_quote: wait until the price has gone at least to the first if not the second standard deviation
confluences.name: vwapsd_extension
confluences.description: Wait for price to extend to at least the first, preferably the second, standard-deviation band away from VWAP.

confluences.transcript_quote: after we broke it and tested it
confluences.name: break_and_retest
confluences.description: Require a break and retest of the VWAP standard-deviation band before entry.
